notes.title: Small Update #10 -2023/9/26
notes.notes:
Bug Fix
Fixed a problem of Phase 20 boss. The fire arena will not spawn too many fire strikes from the ground.

notes.title: Small Update #9 -2023/9/18
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

 Fixed a bug with spear attack animation, the animation might not trigger attack damage when the attack speed it too high. Now it is fixed.
 Fixed a collision problem in phase 13 that may cause enemy spawn on the tree.
 Fixed a problem of phase 10 boss. Now it can drop correct number of shards as reward.

notes.title: Small Update #8 -2023/9/15
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

 Fixed a visual problem at shop menu where mage staff shows wrong models.


Improvement

 Improved enemies' death physical sim effect.
 Improved Phase 10 Boss's skill visual effect.

notes.title: Small Update #7 -2023/9/8
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

 Fixed a problem in purchase period. When a item or weapon is locked, it will correctly refresh now.


Engine Update
Due to Engine Update, the download and installation pack will be as big as new download pak.

notes.title: Small Update 6 - 2023/9/4
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

 Fixed a collision problem in phase 13.


Game Complete Screen

 Fixed a problem that players can't see Game Complete Screen after they finish the phase 20.

notes.title: Small Update #5 - 2023/9/2
notes.notes:
Map collision cause player fall
Many players say that they find some different situations in the map that character can fall out of the map. We have fixed every map collision problems after receiving related feedback. Today's fix is mainly about phase 14 to phase 17.

Fixed enemy fly on the wall bug
Some flying enemies in between phase 14 to 17 could spawn on the edge of the map that they stay on the wall and cant be killed. Today's update made the spawn area more centered so that enemies won't spawn on the edge.

notes.title: Small Update 4-2023/9/2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed

 Fiexed a collision problem in phase 7.


Control Improvement

 Now 'Dodge to character front direction' is set as default. You can switch to 'dodge to mouse direction' if you like.

notes.title: Small Update 3-2023/9/1
notes.notes:
Fixed Bugs

 Fixed a bug that can make character fall in phase 8
 Fixed cursor issue when some players use full screen mode and their cursor is limited in a certain area.

notes.title: Small Update 2-2023/9/1
notes.notes:
New Settings

 Add sound settings in menu, you can change sound setting in mainmenu or in game by pressing ESC
 Add dodge direction settings in Game settings, you can choose to dodge in mouse direction(default) or in character front direction

notes.title: Small Update 2-2023/9/1
notes.notes:
New Settings

 Add sound settings in game
 Now you can change settings in game menu. press ESC to change settings
 Now you can choose to dodge in different directions: either to mouse direction(default) or to player front direction. You can change this settings in Settings-Game.
